full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white studio-like photograph shows two men seated side by side against a rough plaster wall. The man on the left turns toward his companion, smiling in profile. He wears a light, loose robe with a deep central opening and a patterned cap that rises above his head in a compact cylindrical form. His forearms rest on his knees, and a round wristwatch is visible near the center of the composition. The man on the right faces left toward him, returning the smile. His short hair and beard are dark, and his long robe is covered with a denser, more intricate repeating pattern. One arm lies across his lap, the other near his knee, creating an informal, relaxed pose. The wall behind them is mottled with patches, stains, and scratches, ranging from pale gray to charcoal. It provides a plain textured backdrop that lets the contrast between the light robe and patterned fabric carry the visual interest. Soft frontal daylight illuminates both faces and the folds of the clothes, while deeper shadows settle beneath the arms and along the lower edge. The camera is at seated eye level and cropped closely enough to emphasize their relationship rather than the wider setting. The bodies form a broad horizontal pair, with the men's turned faces creating a small exchange at the center. Fine photographic grain preserves the texture of skin, cloth, cap, and wall. The mood is warm and conversational, though the photograph itself remains formally composed and tonally restrained. No additional props or narrative action draw attention away from their shared expression.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、近似影棚感的黑白照片呈现两名男子并肩坐在粗糙灰泥墙前。左边男子转向同伴，以侧脸微笑。他穿浅色宽松长袍，前襟有深色开口，头戴有花纹、紧凑圆筒形的帽子。双前臂放在膝上，构图中央附近可见圆表盘腕表。右边男子向左面对他，回以微笑。短发和胡须深色，长袍布满更密、更复杂的重复纹样。一只手臂横放腿上，另一只靠近膝盖，姿势非正式而放松。身后墙面斑驳，有色块、污迹和刮痕，从浅灰变化至炭色。它提供简单有纹理的背景，使浅色长袍与花纹布料的反差承担视觉趣味。柔和正面日光照亮两张脸与衣褶，更深阴影落在手臂下和下边缘。相机位于坐姿视线高度，裁切足够近，强调两人的关系而非更宽的环境。身体形成宽阔水平一对，两张转向彼此的面孔在中央形成小小交流。细摄影颗粒保留皮肤、布料、帽和墙的质地。情绪温暖而像在交谈，照片本身仍正式安排、色调克制。没有其他道具或叙事动作分散对共享表情的注意。
style_prompt_en: Black-and-white studio photography places a close pair against a plain but visibly weathered textured ground. Soft frontal light describes skin and layered patterned textiles without dramatic cast shadow. Use a broad grayscale, fine grain, and careful focus on expressions, fabric, and surface wear. A seated eye-level crop and turned gazes organize the composition around a quiet exchange, while contrasting light and dark garments provide tonal balance. Keep the poses natural and the backdrop simple; the result should feel formal, intimate, and human.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白影棚摄影把靠近的一对人物放在简单但可见风化质地的底前。柔和正面光刻画肌肤和层叠花纹织物，没有戏剧投影。使用宽广灰阶、细颗粒，并在表情、布料与表面磨损上保持谨慎焦点。坐姿视线同高的裁切和转向彼此的目光，让构图围绕安静交流组织，明暗衣着的反差提供色调平衡。姿态保持自然，背景保持简单；效果正式、亲密且有人情味。
theme_en: Two men in patterned robes sitting together against a textured wall
theme_zh: 两名身穿花纹长袍的男子并坐在斑驳墙前
name: Seydou Keita
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
